correctness.rationale: For m≥3 the length-three theta subdivision meets the two-point cubical configuration model criterion. Derived C0=binom(2m+2,2), C1=6m² and C2=m+7binom(m,2). In the ordered cover every integral H2 cycle injects into H1(graph)⊗H1(graph), whose coordinates on all left-left squares determine it, yet those squares are excluded because every pair meets at the pole; hence H2=0, Euler gives dim H1=binom(m,2). Signed fixed-cell traces for arm permutations and pole flip yield (−1)^flip[binom(fixed arms,2)−transpositions], exactly ∧² permutation-module with pole sign. Explicit independent cell enumeration and signed action checks for m=3,4 corroborated character and cell counts (28,54,24), (45,96,46). The universal conclusion follows from the cellular proof, not finite checks. The quotient rational acyclicity follows by finite-group transfer; no integral representation or higher particle claim.
